Vigilante.name: Vigilante
Vigilante.description:
🎭 You are an unlicensed hero: masked, unpaid and breaking the law to protect people in Musutafu. Not a villain, but not legal either.

⚖️ Hero work without a license is a crime. Police arrest vigilantes even when they save lives, though courts treat them apart from villains.
🏫 A day job or classes, nights on the rooftops, small rescues, close calls with police and sleep during the day.
🤝 Police log every sighting of your costume. A few heroes tolerate you, most do not, and residents start to recognize the mask.
🔓 Learnable later: Gone Before the Cuffs, Snatch-Back.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Parkour +10, Search and Rescue +10, Stealth +5
⚡ Starting technique: Before the Sirens
🎒 Starts with: Homemade vigilante costume, Domino mask, ¥8,000, Backpack, Casual clothes
Vigilante.traitNarrativeEffects:
Legal status: unlicensed hero work, including Quirk use on people outside self-defense, is a crime: vigilantes are arrested and charged even after saving lives, though treated apart from villains. Never hurts bystanders or works for criminals.
Access: rooftops, alleys, fire escapes, known Musutafu routes, a police scanner, a hideout if civilian life allows; no agency, campus or police support.
Obligations: none on paper; in practice: the mask, a separate civilian life, self-treated injuries, villains left for police.
Who notices: police, logging every costume sighting; heroes, a few tolerant; residents who learn the mask; villains whose jobs they spoil; press calling vigilantes a failing system's symptom.
Standing pressures: more incidents than patrol pros (Kamui Woods, Mount Lady, Death Arms) can cover; at year start Stain, the Hero Killer, hunts pros he calls fakes, and the press may link any masked vigilante to him; one seen at a big incident becomes a suspect.
